where.if: AND (LOWER(nickname) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(short_id,'')) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR COALESCE(mobile,'') LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT id,seq_no,short_id,nickname,mobile,status,ai_consent_version,last_login_at,created_at FROM app_user ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_plan WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId}

SELECT COUNT(*) total_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dt.status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) completed_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN dt.status='DOING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) doing_count FROM daily_task dt JOIN daily_package dp ON dp.id=dt.package_id WHERE dt.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND dp.business_date=#{businessDate}
